domain: Retail sales and weather correlation analysis
summary: This database links daily retail sales transactions to weather observations through a store-to-weather-station mapping. The sales_in_weather table records units sold by date, store, and item; the weather table contains comprehensive meteorological measurements (temperature, precipitation, wind, pressure) indexed by station and date. The relation table bridges stores to weather stations (many-to-one mapping). Analysts can correlate sales volumes with weather conditions by joining through the relation table, noting that each store may be linked to a different weather station.
